m.aarti.pad1: Victory, victory to you, Ambā; victory to you, Kātyāyanī. Victory to you, Mother of the world, great queen of the world. Baijnāth is your seat; there you were called by the name Varadātī, the boon-giver.
m.aarti.pad2: You have many names and many abodes; this place too is an abode of happiness. Your flame is in every temple; you were called Yogeśvarī, and your glory is wondrous.
m.aarti.pad3: Everywhere festivals go on and on; in every temple the devotees say: Kātyāyanī is the protector of the body; she cuts the knot of attachment and illusion.
m.aarti.pad4: She frees from false attachment and makes one chant her name. Worship on Thursday, and fix your meditation on Kātyāyanī.
m.aarti.pad5: She will remove every trouble and fill the storehouses to the brim. Whatever devotee calls on the Mother, Kātyāyanī takes away all his suffering.
